description: This file defines a custom table model class 'ScalesTableModel' for use with Java Swing JTable components. It manages a list of Scale objects, providing methods to retrieve data for table display, such as column count, names, cell values, row count, and column classes. The class is designed to be non-editable and provides accessors to set the list of scales.

classes.name: ScalesTableModel
classes.description: A table model class extending DefaultTableModel to handle a list of Scale objects for display in a JTable.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table, based on the predefined column names array.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value to be displayed at a specific row and column, based on the corresponding Scale object.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows, corresponding to the number of Scale objects.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the data in a specific column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates that all cells are non-editable.

methods.name: setScalesList
methods.description: Sets the internal list of Scale objects to be displayed in the table.
